experiment: E07 offline trace replay: 64-request service window on frozen E03/E01 artifacts
latency_note: Offline trace replay: all costs are in units of Top-2 expert calls and decision epochs. No wall-clock, GPU-latency, throughput or bucketing-overhead measurement is made or implied; treating these numbers as real GPU latency is invalid. Same-round GPU bucketing and its grouping overhead (plan step 5) are not executed.

input.students: E01-frozen value students, reused as-is; no refitting, h is the only input

allocators.equal_depth: blind round-robin; max-min fair equal-depth baseline
allocators.random: blind random extra allocation; controls for the budget itself
allocators.single_step_index: gain index I = d1/c1, recomputed after every round
allocators.two_step_package: fixed two-step package d2/c2 reserving two rounds (2 Top-2 calls)
allocators.rolling_window_dp: rolling-horizon exact DP over arrival-ordered chunks of 8 requests on predicted gains; explicit approximation, not the joint full-window optimum
allocators.online_single_step_index: streaming version of the single-step index with a hard per-arrival credit ledger; executions only when affordable

budget_tiers_note: Four tiers at the E03 average-round budgets; the extra-round budget is (avg_rounds - 1) * window_size, and spending is never forced — predicted nonpositive gains are not funded.

diminishing.intermediate_depth_note: E01 artifacts carry realized costs at exactly two depths (T=1 and T=rounds). Per-round gains inside the continuation tail are not measured; they are endpoint-anchored assumptions (a weight vector summing to 1 multiplied by the endpoint delta), reported under both 'diminishing' and 'delayed' profiles as a sensitivity axis.

small_window_exact_dp_gap.upper_bound_note: Exact DP on realized gains over dp_window-request sub-windows; the computable-range upper bound only. The joint DP over the full 64-request window is outside the computable range, and the rolling_window_dp allocator is an explicit approximation, not the joint optimum. A relative gap above 1 means the heuristic's realized total gain is negative — allocations chosen on predicted gains can lose value on mispredicted requests.

reorder.note: Only the online ledger allocator depends on arrival order; the offline allocators are order-invariant by construction and are not repeated.

length_mix.note: Stratified per-quartile NLL is reported per allocator inside each budget tier (stratified_nll, position quartile as length proxy); adversarial length/doc arrival orderings are in the reorder block.

delayed.intermediate_depth_note: E01 artifacts carry realized costs at exactly two depths (T=1 and T=rounds). Per-round gains inside the continuation tail are not measured; they are endpoint-anchored assumptions (a weight vector summing to 1 multiplied by the endpoint delta), reported under both 'diminishing' and 'delayed' profiles as a sensitivity axis.

scope_notes: E01 artifacts carry realized costs at exactly two depths (T=1 and T=rounds). Per-round gains inside the continuation tail are not measured; they are endpoint-anchored assumptions (a weight vector summing to 1 multiplied by the endpoint delta), reported under both 'diminishing' and 'delayed' profiles as a sensitivity axis.

Offline trace replay: all costs are in units of Top-2 expert calls and decision epochs. No wall-clock, GPU-latency, throughput or bucketing-overhead measurement is made or implied; treating these numbers as real GPU latency is invalid. Same-round GPU bucketing and its grouping overhead (plan step 5) are not executed.
Requests are states sampled without replacement from the frozen test split; quality is mean per-request NLL at the baseline action, budget is counted in Top-2 expert calls.
The oracle (realized-delta) allocation is not run on the full window; the small-window exact DP on realized gains is the computable-range upper bound reference only.
